title: This Open Source Agent Beats OpenAI Deep Research
description:
Someone open-sourced a research agent that beats OpenAI's Deep Research and Gemini 🔥

It's called Hyper Research and it turns Claude Code into a PhD level researcher. It splits your question, searchs from every angle, then 4 critics tear the report apart and it rewrites weak parts.

Best bit: every source it reads is saved forever, so report #2 is smarter ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
